verdict.rationale: Choosing data storage region or residency is a fair question for a fraud and compliance SaaS platform like Sardine, but nothing in the evidence pack covers storage regions, residency options, or region selection. The location-related items (e.g. True Piercing unmasking fraudster IPs) are about detection, not where customer data is stored, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
